name: Tun Hasan Temenggung
role: Temenggung before the purge in the Annals
bio: Hasan’s people can carry an order to the watch or witness a customs proceeding. A shahbandar files dues and rulings in the temenggung’s name, not as a personal levy.
notes: fact: Brown names Hasan as Mutahir’s son and temenggung; Pires assigns dues and customs judgment to the office but calls the judge the Bendahara’s brother (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 160, 163; Pires II, pp. 255–256, 273)
inference: Cortesão’s note places Hasan among the purge victims; Brown’s execution sentence does not name him (Pires II, p. 256 n. 1; Brown ch. XXII, p. 163)
gameplay: Salmah’s relationship to Hasan and the player’s port-wide remit as shahbandar are invented (port-official.md §4; port-labour.md §§2, 4)
